title: Publish authoring control-plane contracts
summary: Extend HumbleStudio localhost manifests and native catalog parity with the remaining no-write authoring control-plane descriptors so HumbleControl can discover structured drafts, patch previews, trust levels, safe apply boundaries, registry state, native parity, and smoke contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Connection and prepare-edit manifests advertise structured-edit-draft, patch-preview, manifest-trust-levels, safe-apply-boundary, connection-registry, native-parity-contract, and authoring-e2e-smoke capabilities.
Every supported app export includes descriptors for structured drafts, patch previews, trust level, safe apply boundary, native parity, and smoke checks with writes:false.
Native supported-app catalog rows expose the same contract URLs that the web manifest publishes.
Fallback guards, local preview tests, and documentation assert the new no-write contract.
Verification and promotion evidence are recorded before closing the ticket.

evidence.note: Connection and prepare-edit manifests now publish structuredDraft, patchPreview, trustLevel, safeApplyBoundary, nativeParity, endToEndSmoke, and registry descriptors with writes:false.
The native supported-app catalog exposes matching Control anchors for structured draft, patch preview, trust, registry, native parity, safe apply, and authoring smoke.
Local preview manifest tests passed: 14 tests.
Web fallback contract guard passed and workflow scripts compiled successfully.
String catalog JSON remained valid after adding new supported-app labels.

Native macOS CI build passed through the repo-native xcodegen plus xcodebuild path.
The localization guard searches for L10n usage and legacy .strings/.stringsdict resources both returned no matches, preserving the string catalog approach.
